name: RayBigWorld • Friendly SMP
description:
RayBigWorld is a cross-play survival SMP that connects Java and Bedrock players on a single shared world. Built for families and casual builders who want a low-drama place to log in after dinner.

What you can expect:

- Pure vanilla survival with quality-of-life additions (one-click homes, sleep-skip, basic kits)

- Proximity voice chat (SimpleVoiceChat) - talk to nearby players in 3D audio

- Live web map updated every few minutes - explore the server from your browser

- Bilingual English + French community

- Active moderation with content filters tuned for younger players

- Daily off-host backups so your builds are never lost

- Java + Bedrock + Console (via Geyser) all play together

What we don't do:

- No pay-to-win, no premium ranks, no in-game ads

- No griefing tolerance - region claims protect builds

- No open PVP - fights are opt-in via clearly marked arenas

Connect (Bedrock): raybigworld.duckdns.org (default port, leave blank).

Live map: https://map.raybigworld.duckdns.org/

Discord: https://discord.gg/5tW5EkVh6c

Run by a small team of friends. Looking for people who want a server that feels like a neighborhood, not a marketplace.
